description:
This protocol automates a 3-wash RNA isolation using magnetic beads and a magnetic module GEN2. Purified elutions are transferred to a 384 well plate mounted on a temperature module GEN2.


To purchase tips, reagents, or pipettes, please visit our online store or contact our sales team at info@opentrons.com

Opentrons OT-2
Opentrons P300 GEN2 Multi-Channel Pipette
Opentrons P20 GEN2 Single-Channel Pipette
Opentrons 20uL and 200µL Filter Tips
USA Scientific 12-Well Reservoir, 22ml
USA Scientific 96-Deepwell Plate, 2.4mL #1896-2000
Cole Parmer 384-Well Plate, 50uL
